name: State civil-rights agency complaints and charges: figures printed in state annual reports
description: Complaint and charge counts that state civil-rights agencies print in their own annual reports or publish as open data, one row per figure with the document's URL and a verbatim quote: California Civil Rights Department (2024 intake forms and immediate right-to-sue requests), Illinois Department of Human Rights (charges received and employment charges in fiscal year 2024, charges docketed in 2025) and the Pennsylvania Human Relations Commission (allegations in employment complaints, fiscal years 2021-22 to 2024-25 and the part of 2025-26 so far). Each quote is re-checked against the document, and each Pennsylvania figure against the portal's own aggregate.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). State civil-rights agency complaints and charges: figures printed in state annual reports (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964131
keywords: Illinois Department of Human Rights charges

distribution.name: state-civil-rights.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: state-civil-rights.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: state-civil-rights-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in state-civil-rights-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to state-civil-rights.csv on id.

recordSet.name: state-civil-rights
recordSet.description: The records of State civil-rights agency complaints and charges: figures printed in state annual reports, one per CSV row.

field.name: agency
field.description: The state agency that published the figure

field.name: measure
field.description: What is counted: intake-forms, immediate-right-to-sue, charges-received, employment-charges, charges-docketed or employment-allegations

field.name: period
field.description: Calendar or state fiscal year the figure covers

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: The figure as the agency prints it

field.name: unit
field.description: What the figure counts (units differ by state)

field.name: quote
field.description: The verbatim words in the document that carry the figure (for Pennsylvania, the portal query and its result)

field.name: document
field.description: The report or table the figure comes from

field.name: verified
field.description: The date the quote was last found in the document

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
